title: Reader v2 for kernel-log dumps that lost their KL begin record: infer the head/tail geometry from the end line and the received offsets, verify it against the end line's record and byte counts, mark the dump begin_inferred, and feed the unchanged NAT-089 row logic; test on the real NAT-093 archive (skipped when absent) and on synthetic dumps; mutation pass
acceptance: On the real NAT-093 archive the reader reports one dump with begin_inferred=true, length 170,097, head 8,192, tail 32,768, 345 of 428 records and the 7,968 lost bytes as holes, equal to docs/procedures/nat-093/posthoc.json; a dump whose end line counts do not match the inferred geometry, whose records are not 96-aligned to one tail start, or that has no end line is NOT inferred and is reported as unreadable with the reason.

Dumps with an announced begin are read exactly as NAT-089's reader reads them (the same fixtures give identical results); the analyser rows A1-A8 are the NAT-089 rows applied over the v2 text with a marker that says the begin was inferred; tests, mutation pass under the RAM cap. Nothing here measures the phone.
steps: Derive the geometry and write the reader
